turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's a bank holiday weekend, so three whole days.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lovely. You could squeeze in a short trip somewhere, or finally do those jobs around the house. Which would make you happier on Tuesday?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait a moment, my coworker is here. Please be quiet until I tell you I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm ready when you are, just say the word.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Let me find my keys first.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lucas, have you seen the new one with the space station?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, last weekend. It was okay. The ending was a bit weird.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I won't. Let's just say you'll have questions.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, now I have to watch it. Would you see it again?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Maybe, if you're buying the popcorn.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, three days. Getting away, or catching up on the house?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Jobs. I'll feel so much lighter afterwards.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair. Do the worst one first on Saturday morning, and leave Monday for fun.
